# Vendor-published syslog text. Every message below is copied character-exact
# from a source the VENDOR publishes, cited in the comment above it. Read by
# test/syslogRealLines.test.js (same "# expect:" format as real-captured.txt;
# receivedAt 2026-09-24T02:00:00Z).
#
# The vendor documentation sites themselves (cisco.com, juniper.net,
# arubanetworking.hpe.com, help.mikrotik.com) were NOT reachable from the
# capture sandbox (egress proxy), so the sources are the vendors' own GitHub
# organisations:
#
#   [C1] CiscoDevNet/python_code_samples_network @ fb514124e3ab70acfbf6c7aa97bebe68abbe911a
#        PortFlap_email_alert/sample_log_file.txt ("sh log" of a Catalyst switch)
#        MIT licence, (c) 2019 Cisco Systems, Inc.
#   [C2] CiscoDevNet/cml-community @ d9bf15faa04466808aaa3164d884b98b2f8402f2
#        lab-topologies/ccna-prep/**.yaml — IOS/IOSv-L2 console output in Cisco's
#        CCNA Prep lab guides. BSD 3-Clause, (c) 2020 Cisco Systems, Inc.
#   [J1] Mist-Automation-Programmability/mist_webhook_translator @ 663fa43ee4a11e081915b9348a2efab11108e827
#        src/mist/device_events.json — Junos syslog texts in Juniper Mist's
#        sample device-event webhooks. MIT licence.
#
# Cisco: the sources are console / "show logging" lines, which carry no PRI.
# Each line here is "<PRI>" + the cited text, the PRI being what IOS sends by
# default: facility local7 (23) with the severity digit of the mnemonic, i.e.
# 184 + severity. Nothing after the PRI is changed.
#
# Juniper: [J1] carries the MESSAGE only. The header ("<PRI>Mmm dd hh:mm:ss
# host process[pid]: ") is CONSTRUCTED in the Junos BSD layout; only the text
# after it is cited.
#
# HPE/Aruba and MikroTik: no vendor-published source with exact line text was
# reachable, so none are included (see test/fixtures/syslog/README.md).
#
# ---- Cisco IOS ------------------------------------------------------------------
